reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for kids!!!! Tranquility!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Think of a perfect beach for kids... and this one!!! Crystalline, wave-free water, hot, shallow water! Simply perfect!!! The tent we stayed puts the chairs right perinthin of the water, which is great! Very good to snorkel and see little fish. We stayed at Jeane's tent, excellent food! And we were greeted by John at the parking lot, very polite! I recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

I live in Rio de Janeiro, and I came here waiting for more than I have in Región dos Lagos and Angra. Beautiful beaches, but this one stands out in calmness, different beauty, by the coral wall and warm water. Muro Alto Beach - Ipojuca - PE

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Linda.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with warm waters. Taking the harassment of barkeepers and walkers at all times, of course a great beach for bathing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for kids!!!! Tranquility!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Think of a perfect beach for kids... and this one!!! Crystalline, wave-free water, hot, shallow water! Simply perfect!!! The tent we stayed puts the chairs right perinthin of the water, which is great! Very good to snorkel and see little fish. We stayed at Jeane's tent, excellent food! And we were greeted by John at the parking lot, very polite! I recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Reasonable, nothing special, to go to the beach we have to pay parking and restaurant, felt an abuse and a plunder!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pleasant but nothing special, there are much better places, for already to attend the beach you have to pay parking lot then you have expensive restaurants without quality

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Pernambuco
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me the best beach of pernambuco with incredible nearby hotel Nannai. safe place and calm waters. several bars with fresh fish and lagoons.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No comfort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Little strip of sand. It does not affect the comfort of visitors, only for the guests of the risorts. The tent for visitors is very simple.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with warm waters. Taking the harassment of barkeepers and walkers at all times, of course a great beach for bathing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for kids!!!! Tranquility!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Think of a perfect beach for kids... and this one!!! Crystalline, wave-free water, hot, shallow water! Simply perfect!!! The tent we stayed puts the chairs right perinthin of the water, which is great! Very good to snorkel and see little fish. We stayed at Jeane's tent, excellent food! And we were greeted by John at the parking lot, very polite! I recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

I live in Rio de Janeiro, and I came here waiting for more than I have in Región dos Lagos and Angra. Beautiful beaches, but this one stands out in calmness, different beauty, by the coral wall and warm water. Muro Alto Beach - Ipojuca - PE

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Linda.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with warm waters. Taking the harassment of barkeepers and walkers at all times, of course a great beach for bathing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach for kids!!!! Tranquility!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Think of a perfect beach for kids... and this one!!! Crystalline, wave-free water, hot, shallow water! Simply perfect!!! The tent we stayed puts the chairs right perinthin of the water, which is great! Very good to snorkel and see little fish. We stayed at Jeane's tent, excellent food! And we were greeted by John at the parking lot, very polite! I recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Reasonable, nothing special, to go to the beach we have to pay parking and restaurant, felt an abuse and a plunder!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pleasant but nothing special, there are much better places, for already to attend the beach you have to pay parking lot then you have expensive restaurants without quality

reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me the best beach of pernambuco with incredible nearby hotel Nannai. safe place and calm waters. several bars with fresh fish and lagoons.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No comfort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Little strip of sand. It does not affect the comfort of visitors, only for the guests of the risorts. The tent for visitors is very simple.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviews.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviews.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviews.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviews.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviews.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviews.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Of all the beaches visited, the Muro Alto beach is definitely the best. From natural beauty to frequented environment. Peace, privacy, the possibility to observe marine life without people wanting to sell you things. We are delighted! Much better than Punta Cana.

reviews.text: Little strip of sand. It does not affect the comfort of visitors, only for the guests of the risorts. The tent for visitors is very simple.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Muro Alto BeachBeauty: 10/10Facility to arrive 7/10Kayaking tour + drone photos and videos: 100/10Would you go again? YESOh, my God. Amazing!It's about 10 km from the village, I went on Uber.Get the Uber to the Beach Bar, or he'll leave you in the middle of nothing.And those who go to Uber have a discount on the day use of Bar da Praia (the guy of the room who said).I don't know where the public access is there without going through that bar.Region with luxury resorts.It does not need to be with the tide so low, because the coral wall “secures” the sea, forming the natural pool (the largest in Latin America).I made a clear kayaking tour (there is the normal), with photos and drones and I say, just do it! The value is medium high, but worth every penny (R$170 - transparent boat + photos and 2 videos).These were the best photos and videos of my trip to PG.Vc goes to the Coral Wall and walks there (use shoes).If the tide is not very low, it stays deep in the middle, but in general it has quite a shallow part.Day use: Bar da Praia, in Nov. R$ 30 (but we did not pay for the bill that we watched an investment presentation in the resort.) If you have time left, why not? With us it was good, but I have read negative experiences.The Bar I found very good, price ok by place and structure, chopp R$ 12. Clear meals over R$ 100, but 1 dish gave for two people peacefully.There's a pool. Beach Bar 10/10Beach 7/10 because they still offer you tours there and even fight and well-filled the sand, if you don't stay in a tent I think you can't even stay there.The access I put 7/10 because they are 12 km from the village (up to the Bar) and I do not know the access without being by resort or these beach clubs.  Buggy's end-to-end ride goes there.

reviews.title: PARADIS PLAYA MURO ALTO - PE
reviews.text: Sorry I only managed to find this beach at the end of my tour for me was one of the best. I was already disappointed with the beaches. I live in Rio de Janeiro, and I came here waiting for more than I have in Región dos Lagos and Angra. Beautiful beaches, but this one stands out in calmness, different beauty, by the coral wall and warm water. Muro Alto Beach - Ipojuca - PE

reviews.title: Linda.
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with warm waters. Taking the harassment of barkeepers and walkers at all times, of course a great beach for bathing.

reviews.title: Perfect beach for kids!!!! Tranquility!!!
reviews.text: Think of a perfect beach for kids... and this one!!! Crystalline, wave-free water, hot, shallow water! Simply perfect!!! The tent we stayed puts the chairs right perinthin of the water, which is great! Very good to snorkel and see little fish. We stayed at Jeane's tent, excellent food! And we were greeted by John at the parking lot, very polite! I recommend!

reviews.title: Quiet sea with fish and crabs in the surrounding area.
reviews.text: The beach due to the "high wall" that gives its name, looks like a swimming pool when we have the low tide. This makes it possible to have a lot of tranquility to stay in the water with children, between fish and if you have an attentive look, also with small crabs but due to the change of tide, the sand looks like mud when the tide is low and you are expelled from the sand when the tide rises. Interesting but there are better options for the country.

reviews.title: Reasonable, nothing special, to go to the beach we have to pay parking and restaurant, felt an abuse and a plunder!!!
reviews.text: Pleasant but nothing special, there are much better places, for already to attend the beach you have to pay parking lot then you have expensive restaurants without quality
